gaps.sentence: The book gives a detailed ___ account of the period.
gaps.hint: connected with the study of the past
gaps.explanation: 'Historical' means relating to history or the past; 'historic' means important in history.

gaps.sentence: This small car is very ___ to run.
gaps.explanation: 'Economical' means costing little or saving money; 'economic' relates to trade, industry or the economy.

gaps.sentence: We had great ___ at the beach party.
gaps.explanation: 'Fun' is an uncountable noun meaning enjoyment; 'funny' is an adjective meaning causing laughter.

gaps.sentence: He ___ on the sofa all afternoon yesterday.
gaps.explanation: 'Lay' is the past of 'lie' (recline): he lay on the sofa. 'Laid' would need an object.

gaps.sentence: Please be ___ — the baby is sleeping.
gaps.explanation: 'Quiet' means making little or no noise; 'quite' is an adverb meaning fairly or completely.
'Valuable' means worth a lot of money; 'valued' means appreciated; 'invaluable' already means priceless, so it is not graded.
'Than' is used in comparisons; 'then' refers to time or consequence.

gaps.sentence: There is little ___ that the plan will be approved.
gaps.hint: pattern: little ___ that something will happen
gaps.explanation: 'Possibility that ...' is the standard pattern; 'opportunity' means a situation that lets you do something.
